quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: building on precision waveguide design and high-speed high-stability drawing, FiberHome has a full-spectrum 780/980/1310/1550nm polarization-maintaining fiber product range that can meet custom needs (ultra bend resistance, high-temperature resistance, thin diameter) and can be applied in CPO/NPO devices, sensing devices, coherent optical modules and passive devices; it will plan capacity according to its judgment of industry supply and demand.
